title: React v2 Global Command Palette: Cmd+K navigation and quick actions
goal: Implement a global command palette triggered by Cmd+K (or Ctrl+K). This palette should allow users to instantly search across engagements, jump to specific findings, navigate between screens, or trigger quick actions (like 'New Mission'). This heavily increases the 'enterprise' power-user feel and improves navigation speed drastically.
scope: React v2 global UI components and testing.
generation_reason: To ensure the UI is fully polished, user-friendly, enterprise-ready, and robustly tested.
